verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document an API for pulling POS transactions or payouts, nor any daily-takings reconciliation or ledger/accounting export that an agent could drive. The only API-related item says POS UI extensions can query the GraphQL Admin API. That is a developer building block for in-POS extensions, not a documented transactions/payouts reconciliation capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger
